alternatives_rejected: Treat the strict lead view as the whole news day
Promote bounded snippets or generic training pages automatically
Treat stale or ambiguous-time pages as current GW1 evidence
decision_trace.decision: Retain all 100 capture candidates as research signals and admit no governed player claims
falsifiers: A current official original supplies an exact publication time and precise player availability or lineup claim
A fresh official source contradicts the broad-capture interpretation
decision_trace.rationale: Freshness-first capture searched all 21 catalogue buckets and returned 100 candidates: 62 known-time and 38 unknown-time, with 53 official candidates, nine official feeds and 38 external candidates. The strict view has one dated official generic pre-season page and no player claim. The broad capture is therefore not an empty news day, but it does not support ledger admission.

alternatives_rejected: Edit packet start probabilities from snippets
Admit undated official pages as current availability claims
Ignore unknown-time candidates because the strict view is sparse
decision_trace.decision: Retain Bruno, Haaland, Joao Pedro, Thiago, Leeds forwards and Spurs goalkeeper competition as monitoring signals only
falsifiers: A current official team sheet or press update confirms or rules out a named player
Human verification supplies a precise timestamp and claim text
decision_trace.rationale: Clusters were reviewed across Manchester United, Manchester City, Chelsea, Brentford, Leeds and Tottenham. Official pages were preferred, but the decision-changing rows were stale, generic or unknown-time; independent/community predicted lineups are corroboration or challenge only. No new start probability, minutes estimate or availability claim is written to the ledger.

falsifiers: Bootstrap identity resolution shows a declared watchlist UID is not current-season exact
decision_trace.rationale: The watchlist contains exact current-season IDs from the weekly packet deterministic and robust comparator universe plus the local GW1 expected-points shortlist. No unresolved capture candidate is added as a player value or claim, preserving exact identity and point-in-time discipline.
